rejectedArtwork.title: PES 6
rejectedArtwork.sourceNote: Destination og:image (og:image:alt = "PES 6 Web Online Port"), the wordmark served by the host itself. No gameplay screenshot is published on the destination, so this is the strongest genuine source available.
caveats: Wordmark, not a screenshot: 898x162 (aspect 5.54) against a 1.88 card window, so the card centre-crops it to roughly the middle third of the wordmark.
Low resolution for a 460x245 card. Replace if the host ever publishes a screenshot.
